triage.proposed_comment: The immediate failure — the background task crashing because it tried to parse an RFC3339 date string as a unix integer — was fixed in commit ae0c3302 (July 2020). The current code in `discordbot/background.py:299` correctly calls `dtutil.parse_rfc3339(league['end_date'])`. The broader API date-format discussion (RFC3339 vs ISO 8601) from the comments was not resolved, but the bug itself is gone.

verify.final_comment: The immediate bug — background task crashing because it called datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp() on an RFC3339 string — was fixed in commit ae0c3302 (July 2020). The current code in discordbot/background.py:299 correctly calls dtutil.parse_rfc3339(league['end_date']). The broader API date-format discussion (RFC3339 vs ISO 8601) from the thread was never resolved, but the original reporter noted in Nov 2021 that no further action was planned and suggested closing.
